_doc: Daily login rewards (Design/30). unlock = feature id in tutorial.json. milestone_interval: a milestone every N claimed days, rewards rotate through milestones. cycle = 6 regular slots (days 1-6), grand = the day-7 slot rotating by grand_ordinal. Each reward: gems | driver_coupon{pro,allstar} | gear_coupon{standard,elite}. gem_scale multiplies the gem part (flag daily_gem_scale). Numbers are starting values and must be rebalanced in the lab (Design/30 §9).
